_note: Sampling per study, applied by gateway.py. DeepSeek's model card recommends temperature 1.0 with top_p 0.95 for agentic use and top_p 1.0 otherwise. Measured on the served 0731 model: with no chat_template_kwargs it does a short reasoning pass by default (31-64 reasoning tokens on one-line questions); thinking=false turns reasoning off completely. chat-nothink forces it off, chat-think asks for high effort, the other studies use the model's default. max_tokens is only set when the harness sends none.
